content.text: I read the release and checked each item in the brief against it. Here's what I found.

facts.evidence: Revenues increased by 2.3% to $31.6 billion year over year.
Adjusted EPS was $0.65, up from $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.

Advanced Connectivity service revenues grew by 5.1% year over year, with operating income up 20.3% and EBITDA up 8.0%. (growth rate correct; the $23.5 billion dollar amount is omitted but nothing is misstated)
Adjusted EBITDA grew by 5.2% to $12.3 billion year over year.
Reiterates full-year 2026 guidance for adjusted EBITDA growth in the 3% to 4% range and adjusted EPS of $2.25 to $2.35.
Free cash flow was $4.7 billion, up from $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
including 646,000 internet net adds (367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless) and 432,000 postpaid phone net adds

claims.claim: Revenues increased 2.3% year over year to $31.6 billion.
claims.note: Release: revenues totaled $31.6 billion, versus $30.8 billion, up 2.3%.

claims.claim: Adjusted EPS was $0.65, up from $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.
claims.note: Release states adjusted EPS of $0.65 versus $0.54.

claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA grew 5.2% year over year to $12.3 billion.
claims.note: Release: adjusted EBITDA $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year.

claims.claim: Free cash flow was $4.7 billion, versus $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
claims.note: Release states free cash flow of $4.7 billion versus $4.4 billion.

claims.claim: Advanced Connectivity service revenues grew 5.1% year over year.
claims.note: Release: Advanced Connectivity service revenues grew 5.1%.

claims.claim: Advanced Connectivity operating income was up 20.3% year over year.
claims.note: Release: operating income growth of 20.3%.

claims.claim: Advanced Connectivity EBITDA was up 8.0% year over year.
claims.note: Release: EBITDA of $12.0 billion, up 8.0%.

claims.claim: AT&T added over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers in the quarter.
claims.note: Release highlights: added over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers.

claims.claim: Internet net adds were 646,000, comprising 367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless.
claims.note: Release: 646,000 internet net adds, including 367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless.

claims.claim: Postpaid phone net adds were 432,000.
claims.note: Release: 432,000 postpaid phone net adds.

claims.claim: Latin America segment revenues increased 16.1% year over year, driven by favorable foreign exchange rates and postpaid wireless subscriber growth.
claims.note: Release: Latin America revenues up 16.1%, driven by favorable FX and postpaid wireless subscriber growth.

claims.claim: AT&T reiterates full-year 2026 guidance for adjusted EBITDA growth in the 3% to 4% range.
claims.note: Release reiterates all full-year 2026 guidance; outlook includes adjusted EBITDA growth of 3% to 4% in 2026.

claims.claim: AT&T reiterates full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $2.25 to $2.35.
claims.note: Release outlook: adjusted EPS of $2.25 to $2.35 in 2026.

claims.claim: AT&T plans to return $45 billion+ to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases during 2026-2028.
claims.note: Release: plans to return $45 billion+ to shareholders during 2026-2028.

claims.claim: Capital investment is expected to be in the $23 billion to $24 billion range annually during 2026-2028.
claims.note: Release outlook states this range annually for 2026-2028.

claims.claim: Total debt was $144.0 billion at the end of Q2.
claims.note: Release: total debt of $144.0 billion at the end of the second quarter.

claims.claim: Net debt was $126.4 billion.
claims.note: Release: net debt of $126.4 billion at June 30, 2026.

claims.claim: AT&T returned $4.1 billion to shareholders, including approximately $2.2 billion in common share repurchases.
claims.note: Release: returned $4.1 billion, including approximately $2.2 billion in repurchases under the 2024 authorization.

claims.claim: The company has an accelerated share repurchase program.
claims.note: Release: accelerating the pace of planned share repurchases this year to approximately $10 billion.

claims.claim: Legacy service revenues are in continued decline.
claims.note: Release: Legacy revenues continued to decline year over year; outlook projects a 20%+ Legacy service revenue decline in 2026.
